entities.name: CSV/Excel Raw Data
entities.rationale: Hand-drawn box labelled 'CSV / XLS' outside and to the left of the Data Ingestion dashed box; external source of raw trade data uploaded into S3.

entities.name: Amazon S3 (Raw Data)
entities.rationale: Top-left icon inside the 'Data Ingestion' dashed container; receives the raw CSV/Excel uploads.

entities.name: AWS Lambda (Validation)
entities.rationale: Top-middle icon inside the 'Data Ingestion' dashed container; triggered by the raw S3 bucket to validate data.

entities.name: Amazon S3 (Validated Data)
entities.rationale: Top-right icon inside the 'Data Ingestion' dashed container; stores the validated copy of the data.

entities.name: AWS Lambda (Processing)
entities.rationale: Bottom-right icon inside the 'Data Ingestion' dashed container; triggered by validated data, processes and ingests it into OpenSearch.

entities.name: AWS OpenSearch (Ingestion)
entities.rationale: Icon inside the 'Data Ingestion' dashed container, annotated with a Graviton2 chip symbol; target of the processing Lambda.

entities.name: User
entities.rationale: Actor icon labelled 'User' outside and to the left of the 'Data Retrieval' dashed box; handwritten 'Web' and 'Mob' annotations indicate access by web browser and mobile app.

entities.name: Frontend Application (FE)
entities.rationale: Hand-drawn box labelled 'FE' inside the 'Data Retrieval' dashed container; Angular front-end web application.

entities.name: Backend Application (BE)
entities.rationale: Hand-drawn box labelled 'BE' inside the 'Data Retrieval' dashed container; Python backend application that queries the data layer.

entities.name: AWS OpenSearch (Retrieval)
entities.rationale: Icon inside the 'Data Retrieval' dashed container, annotated with a Graviton2 chip symbol; part of the data layer queried by the backend.

entities.name: Amazon RDS
entities.rationale: Icon inside the 'Data Retrieval' dashed container, next to the BE box; part of the data layer, with arrows drawn to and from the backend.

entities.name: Amazon S3 (Reports)
entities.rationale: Icon at the right of the 'Data Retrieval' dashed container, marked with a short hand-drawn arrow; stores large reports for download via pre-signed URL.

entities.name: Amazon SES
entities.rationale: Icon at the bottom-right of the 'Data Retrieval' dashed container; sends the user a notification email with the report download link.

visual_connections.description: Arrow drawn from the CSV/XLS box to the first S3 bucket: raw files are uploaded.
Arrow from the first S3 bucket to the top Lambda: upload triggers validation.
Arrow from the top Lambda to the second S3 bucket: validated copy is stored.
Short arrow drawn pointing up from the lower Lambda to the validated S3 bucket; per the transcript, the validated data in this bucket triggers the Lambda.
Arrow from the lower Lambda to OpenSearch: processed data is ingested into the cluster.
Arrow labelled 'Web' from the user to the FE box: web browser request to the front end.
Return arrow from the FE box back to the user's browser.
Line from the user ('Mob' annotation) to the BE box: browser and mobile app requests go to the backend.
Return arrows from the BE box back towards the user: response is sent via the backend.
Arrows drawn in both directions between the BE box and the data layer at the RDS icon: request and response.
Arrow from the BE box pointing up towards the data layer; the backend queries OpenSearch and receives the response (endpoint inferred from the transcript, the drawn arrow is short).
Short arrow drawn pointing into the reports S3 bucket: large reports (over 10,000 records) are uploaded. Source inferred from the transcript; the drawn arrow has no visible origin.
